mentions.name: FACET
mentions.description: This project provides a deterministic execution layer for AI systems, treating LLMs as constrained components inside explicitly defined workflows with strict input/output schemas, validated DAGs, clear failure modes, and replayable execution, so AI behavior becomes testable, debuggable, and reproducible.
mentions.problem: Most "AI unreliability" isn't model-related — it comes from ambiguous structure and hidden assumptions around the model.
mentions.source_excerpt: We’re exploring this through a project called FACET, focused on making AI behavior testable, debuggable, and reproducible in the same way we expect from other parts of a system.
